uncertainties.detail: Stop/code observations provide no coordinate or source-path identifier. No code is assigned merely from color, apparent side, track ordinal or presumed right-hand operation. Every reviewed physical rail carries an explicit unresolved direction/code status.

8197 connects center 8202, while frozen M11N M observations report J2. It crosses local 8261 without a physical endpoint. Do not change that crossing into a junction or label 8202 J2 to force a through journey.

M11–M16 have J north/J1 and M south/J1, plus J south/J2 and M north/J2; M18 has M north/J2, M south/J1, J north/JM and J south/J2. Once physical identity is established, platformDirections aliases must share physical nodes without reverse edges.
J27S has frozen JM, but no northbound JM observation. Center geometry is reviewed; bidirectionality and code identity through Myrtle are not established.
